speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to begin my assessment, has this breathing difficulty started immediately after birth, and are you experiencing any feeding difficulties or cyanosis?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Given the history of prematurity (33 weeks) and the onset of distress within two hours of birth, I am highly confident in this diagnosis. Please confirm if there are any signs of grunting, flaring, or retractions, and request a Chest_X-Ray to visualize the characteristic ground-glass appearance.
